request: Publish a draft PR with fixture evidence and require full validation when it becomes ready.
scope: Support the canonical COPS repository and protect its default branch.
setup: Use Python 3.14, the pinned scanners, the installed gate and GitHub CLI with read access to effective rules and bypass actors.
constraints: Keep security scans, branch-wide issue and test checks, and focused acceptance at publication. Require every full check before merge.

steps.action: Add the draft destination profile, effective ruleset check and matching ready-for-review validation.

verify.command: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_local_push_gate.py -k test_draft
verify.expected: Draft selection and all transition and enforcement boundaries pass.

acceptance.entrypoint: COPS local push gate and repository contract workflow
acceptance.given: A canonical push requests the draft profile.
acceptance.when: Compare its commands with the ordinary push profile.
acceptance.then: Only make check and the full coverage run and report are deferred.

acceptance.entrypoint: COPS local push gate and repository contract workflow
acceptance.given: A draft targets the canonical remote or a different remote.
acceptance.when: Evaluate active and bypassable or incomplete protection responses.
acceptance.then: Only an active, complete ruleset on the canonical remote permits publication.

acceptance.entrypoint: COPS local push gate and repository contract workflow
acceptance.given: A pull request is ready or draft and the two prerequisite jobs return terminal states.
acceptance.when: Run the required validation step with each combination of job results.
acceptance.then: Only ready with both prerequisites successful allows the full suite to run.

acceptance.entrypoint: COPS local push gate and repository contract workflow
acceptance.given: One commit can target multiple refs in a single push.
acceptance.when: Select a profile for each unique pushed tip.
acceptance.then: Any ordinary destination requires full validation for that tip.
